# Results (generated by `python -m src.train`)

## Data
- Rows loaded: 1000; after cleaning: 990
- Class counts (0=Negative, 1=Positive): {'negative_0': 497, 'positive_1': 493}
- Train / test sizes: 792 / 198 (stratified, seed 42)

## Cross-validation on the training split (model selection)
| Model | Best CV F1 | Best parameters |
|---|---|---|
| Multinomial Naive Bayes | 0.8264 | `{'clf__alpha': 0.3, 'tfidf__min_df': 1, 'tfidf__ngram_range': [1, 2]}` |
| Linear SVM | 0.8332 | `{'clf__C': 1.0, 'tfidf__min_df': 1, 'tfidf__ngram_range': [1, 2]}` |

## Held-out test results (positive class = Positive)
| Model | Accuracy | Precision | Recall | F1 | ROC-AUC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Multinomial Naive Bayes | 0.8283 | 0.8351 | 0.8182 | 0.8265 | 0.8960 |
| Linear SVM | 0.8434 | 0.8469 | 0.8384 | 0.8426 | 0.9085 |

**Selected model:** Linear SVM (highest cross-validated F1 on the training split; the test set was not used to choose).

## Confusion matrices (rows = actual Neg/Pos, columns = predicted Neg/Pos)

- Linear SVM: `[[84, 15], [16, 83]]`
